overview: The paper proposes a guidance-based watermarking method for diffusion models that converts any post-hoc watermarking scheme into an in-generation embedding by modifying the noise estimate during the diffusion sampling process, evaluated on image quality preservation and robustness against various image transformations and adversarial attacks.

modules.name: Configuration and Experiment Management
modules.description: Manages global experimental settings, including hyperparameter definitions (guidance strength, scheduling, clipping thresholds), random seed fixing, and logging infrastructure for tracking experiment states and metrics.

modules.name: Data and Prompt Management
modules.description: Loads and preprocesses text prompts for generation and reference image datasets (e.g., COCO) for distribution-based metric computation, handling tokenization and batching for the diffusion model.

modules.name: Watermark Decoder Interface
modules.description: Wraps pre-trained watermark decoders (e.g., Stable Signature, VideoSeal) to extract feature vectors from images. Ensures the forward pass is differentiable to allow gradient backpropagation for the guidance mechanism.

modules.name: Watermark Guidance Loss
modules.description: Calculates the cosine similarity loss between the target watermark vector (message or secret key) and the feature vector extracted from the generated image, serving as the objective function for the gradient guidance.

modules.name: Differentiable Augmentation Pipeline
modules.description: Applies a set of differentiable image transformations (e.g., JPEG approximation, cropping, brightness/contrast adjustments) to the generated image during the guidance phase to compute robustness-aware gradients.

modules.name: Gradient Conflict Resolution
modules.description: Implements the PCGrad algorithm to aggregate gradients computed from multiple different augmentation branches, resolving conflicts where gradient directions from different transformations diverge.

modules.name: Guided Diffusion Sampling Engine
modules.description: Modifies the reverse diffusion sampling loop by injecting the aggregated watermark guidance gradient into the noise estimate. Applies gradient clipping and scaling, and manages the guidance scheduling (e.g., starting guidance at a specific timestep) and simplification (replacing latent gradient with image space gradient).

modules.name: Statistical False Alarm Calibration
modules.description: Computes theoretical p-values for zero-bit watermark detection based on the cosine similarity score. Implements the whitening process for decoder features to ensure statistical isotropy and reliable false alarm rate estimation.

modules.name: Image Quality Evaluation
modules.description: Calculates perceptual and distributional metrics to assess the impact of watermarking on generation quality, including FID against a reference dataset, CLIP score for text-image alignment, and pixel-level metrics (PSNR, LPIPS) comparing watermarked and non-watermarked images.

modules.name: Watermark Robustness Evaluation
modules.description: Evaluates watermark detectability and decodability under various distortions. Computes bit accuracy, payload capacity (via RCU bound), and zero-bit detection probability at specified low false alarm rates.

modules.name: Attack Simulation Suite
modules.description: Implements a suite of image transformations and adversarial attacks to test watermark robustness, including geometric attacks, valuemetric attacks, VAE purification, regeneration attacks, and the average attack.

modules.name: Baseline Watermark Methods
modules.description: Integrates existing in-generation and post-hoc watermarking baselines (e.g., Tree-Ring, Gaussian Shading, Stable Signature VAE fine-tuning, VideoSeal post-hoc) for comparative benchmarking.

modules.name: Spectrum and Visual Analysis
modules.description: Computes and visualizes the 2D Fourier spectrum of watermarked versus non-watermarked images to analyze frequency band distribution, and generates image residual maps for qualitative assessment.

modules.name: Experiment Orchestration
modules.description: Coordinates the end-to-end experimental pipeline, executing generation, attack application, and evaluation loops for main results, comparisons, and ablation studies (e.g., varying the number of guidance steps or hyperparameters).
